title: 未接続フィールドの接続と敵配置案

scope.quest_instances: preserve IDs, goals, conditions and fixed levels
scope.enemy_source: v8 roster and source points; point markers are reference, not population counts
scope.water_combat: combat is possible in encounter areas; retain observation/safe transit; preserve Q-FON-S05
scope.hop_metric: same-region shortest counted edge from a named hub on the design graph; does not prove the route is currently walkable
scope.level_rule: route-based bands alongside regional ranges; proposals are fixed field values, not dynamic scaling
scope.no_auto_creation: all routes are review proposals. Candidate reachability is graph-only, regardless of actual unlock and direction.
scope.browser_drafts: not visible in GitHub. Compare browser export before adoption, especially the two Dawn Port routes.
